name: Inbucket Self-Hosted Email Test Server
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted disposable SMTP inbox server with built-in web UI, REST API and POP3; no vendor-imposed software quota or expiry.
watch_out: Runs on your own Docker host or machine; compute and storage are not included. Test inboxes accept mail without account setup and are not suitable for confidential production mailboxes; configure retention and mailbox caps.
